## Music keeps playing next to games and apps (Android)
- **No more stopping when you open a game or app:** Streyn now handles audio focus itself. Games, short app sounds and apps that only grab the audio no longer pause the music. A short sound makes it quieter for a moment, then it is back at full volume
- **Still polite like Spotify:** calls, voice messages being recorded and other music, video or podcast apps still pause it. After a call or a short interruption it carries on by itself
- **Android 12 and newer:** when a game takes the audio, Streyn asks for it once more so the system does not mute the music next to the game. If the game keeps taking it back, Streyn pauses instead of fighting
- **New switch:** Settings → Devices → "Keep playing next to games and apps" (on by default). Off = the old behaviour

## Install
- **Android:** update the app (Settings → Updates, or the new APK from this release), the change is in the app itself
- **Server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script) for the new switch text
- **Windows / Linux:** nothing changes, desktop and browser never paused for other apps
